en: Black-and-white postcard view of a small rural railway station with wooden buildings in traditional Scandinavian style. A main two‑storey station house with steep gabled roof and white-trimmed dark wooden siding stands beside railway tracks. A semaphore signal and a small locomotive or railcar are visible to the left, along with additional small sheds. Text printed at the top identifies the railway and station, and signs on the station building display the station name.
